Perfect.'), so 'accepted' is inferred, not observed.

anchors.raw: And I've been watching some of those videos and I actually was trying to get some kettlebells. And I just thought, thought I would give it a shot. You know, nothing, nothing really more than that.
anchors.note: He arrived intending to buy a couple of kettlebells and self-coach off free content — an effectively zero-cost substitute already in his head. The rep never surfaced or dismantled this before quoting $6,000.

anchors.raw: you kind of need to keep going to the gym and keep paying the gym if you want to keep up with the progress and the program and whatever
anchors.note: The prospect's reference price for coached training is a CrossFit box membership, where programming, coaching and community were included for a monthly fee. The rep raised the comparison himself to argue for education-over-dependency, but in doing so re-anchored on a cheap monthly model.
